facts.business: Marine Electricals (India) Limited provides electrical and automation solutions for marine, defence, power distribution, EV charging, and data centre sectors.

guidance_or_targets.statement: With the continued expansion of our product portfolio and our ability to offer a broader range of solutions to our customers, we anticipate further strengthening of our order book during FY 2026–27.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding final arbitration award received on 1 August 2024 directing payment of principal along with interest to a sub-contractor; Company paid principal of Rs. 2,185.88 lakhs and provided for balance principal of Rs. 216.91 lakhs; provided and paid interest of Rs. 949.54 lakhs and provided for interest of Rs. 474.50 lakhs.

key_risks: Global tariff regimes and geopolitical tensions including conflict in West Asia creating supply chain and capital flow disruptions
Arbitration award liability requiring payment of principal and interest to sub-contractor
